name: Classic Wheeled Robot Simulation Env
postStartCommand: bash -c '. /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.sh && . /ros2_control_ws/install/setup.sh && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y --skip-keys "rapidcheck pytest ros2_control" || true && colcon build --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON --packages-up-to robot_bringup robot_control robot_world robot_navigation && python3 -c "import json, pathlib; files=list(pathlib.Path(\"build\").rglob(\"compile_commands.json\")); merged=[]; [merged.extend(json.loads(f.read_text())) for f in files]; pathlib.Path(\"compile_commands.json\").write_text(json.dumps(merged, indent=2))"'
